result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the lack of visible traffic control and the presence of parked cars near the crossing may impact visibility and safety.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near crosswalk
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side of the image obstruct the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacks marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the visible intersection. result.summary: The image shows a marked zebra crosswalk on a narrow street adjacent to a large institutional building, likely a school. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the crossing lacks active traffic control and suffers from visual obstructions due to parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street are positioned very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, just beyond the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks a stop sign or signal to regulate vehicle flow, which is a concern in a school zone.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crosswalk to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming infrastructure. The presence of parked vehicles along both curbs creates significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations without priority.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, especially children, at potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: Speed humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical deflection measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.
